    <content type="html"><h2><a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/compare/0.124.0...0.124.1">0.124.1</a> (2026-10-08)</h2>
<h3>Features</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> record cost without a threshold (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11451" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11451/hovercard">#11451</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/037f1f6a126a7ef39fc08c321935ad19fcc7c2d4">037f1f6</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> add OpenAI Decisions support (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11454" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11454/hovercard">#11454</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/2dbf3ecc75966e6d924c2c9dde5bcbd5c0cd2d2f">2dbf3ec</a>)</li>
<li><strong>providers:</strong> expose catalog text-token pricing (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11452" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11452/hovercard">#11452</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/3ecce2ebf721ed596735714e866d13b76c7f988e">3ecce2e</a>)</li>
</ul>
<h3>Bug Fixes</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> preserve async expression grading (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11453" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11453/hovercard">#11453</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/1df3eb8e0bacad7efc64bce2bd3a7df0094a1d61">1df3eb8</a>)</li>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> preserve keyword-property grading (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11450" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11450/hovercard">#11450</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/a2da804bcb09b05dbab58ce2db7429c59789e8a0">a2da804</a>)</li>
<li><strong>assertions:</strong> preserve regex operands after yield (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/issues/11463" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/promptfoo/promptfoo/pull/11463/hovercard">#11463</a>) (<a href="https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo/commit/4b4151a369a5972996de82fd9f14aef221003629">4b4151a</a>)</li>
